notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Since 500 of you have bought the game since April 10th (when Blue Prince came out), I think it might be worth it to update it to a playable state.[/h3][h2][b]
Added:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Challenge levels for after you complete the game. There's currently one, but next week I'll add a second and third.[/p][/*][*][p]New credits.[/p][/*][*][p]Options menu (now accessible from the main menu!)[/p][/*][*][p]Advertisement (singular) please give me more money[/p][/*][*][p]New camera controls[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly different logo[/p][/*][*][p]Fun little star when you win :)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]
Fixed:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The key at the end of that stupid walking level now completes the level when you walk into it.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "City" to "Night" in a certain place.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed placeholder items from levels.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer fall into the void forever in any level.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the link at the end of the credits.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now save the game without Steam open.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]
Known issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Still no pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse sensitivity may vary level-to-level[/p][/*][*][p]No sensitivity slider in Settings[/p][p]These and more will be fixed next week with the extra levels[/p][/*][/list]
